# Mythic Territories

> A free browser-based, turn-based strategy game where players command elemental factions — Frost or Ash — in tactical head-to-head combat. No installation or registration required.

## About the Game

Mythic Territories is a competitive, grid-based tactical strategy game built for the modern web (React 19, Vite, Firebase). Two commanders battle across an elemental board using distinct faction units, each possessing unique movement ranges, combat stats, and passive or active abilities. The game features an Ascension progression mechanic, single-player vs AI with strategic pathfinding, local 2-player pass-and-play, and real-time online multiplayer with room codes.

## Key Pages

- [Home / Lobby](https://mythic-territories.xyz/) — Start a local match, play vs AI, or create/join an online room

## Elemental Factions

### Frost Faction (Ice / Control)
- **Playstyle:** Defensive positioning, lane denial, freeze status effects, high survivability, and battlefield manipulation.
- **Key Units:** Arctic Trapper, Cryomancer, Frost Lord, Glacial Brute, Hoarfrost Mystic, Ice Weaver, Snow Wolf, Soul Freeze, Soul Linker, Void Chanter, Wisp, Yeti.

### Ash Faction (Fire / Aggression)
- **Playstyle:** High offensive burst, aggressive zone control, burn effects, high mobility, and explosive frontline pressure.
- **Key Units:** Ash Reaper, Ash Tyrant, Blaze Runner, Cinder Scout, Hell Hound, Magma Prowler, Magma Shaper, Magma Spitter, Rift Forger, Scorch Priest, Obsidian Shaper.

## Core Mechanics

- **Turn-Based Grid Combat:** Move and attack on a tactical grid with terrain and line-of-sight considerations.
- **Faction Leaders:** Each commander leads their army with signature abilities that can shift the momentum of the match.
- **Ascension System:** Units can ascend into empowered forms during combat, gaining enhanced stats and abilities.
- **Game Modes:**
  - *Single-Player vs AI:* Dedicated Web Worker AI providing responsive tactical play without UI stutter.
  - *Local 2-Player:* Pass-and-play on a shared screen.
  - *Online Multiplayer:* Low-latency serverless room matchmaking and real-time game state synchronization via Firebase Firestore.

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend:** React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP for smooth animations
- **Multiplayer Backend:** Serverless Firebase Cloud Firestore for real-time room synchronization and matchmaking
- **AI Processing:** Dedicated client-side Web Worker for asynchronous move calculation
- **Optimization:** Brotli & Gzip pre-compression, responsive WebP asset pipeline, PWA manifest, self-hosted fonts
